# Serie A 2018/19–2025/26 historical bookmaker odds gap recovery — source assessment
id: req-20261001-007 | researched 2026-10-01 23:12 (Asia/Shanghai)

Scope honored: local inventory already holds football-data I1 bulk files for 2021/22–2025/26, so this pass targets the **2018/19–2020/21** gap seasons and confirms **2025/26 completeness**. Bet365/Pinnacle/William Hill kept separate; 1X2 and total-goals (OU2.5) kept separate.

## 1. Verdict

- **2019/20 and 2020/21**: full coverage from football-data.co.uk — pre-close + closing 1X2 for Bet365, Pinnacle, William Hill; pre-close + closing OU2.5 for Bet365 and Pinnacle (no WH OU columns in any season). 380 rows per season file, all wanted columns present (30/30).
- **2018/19**: PARTIAL. 380 rows present, but the file carries only: pre-close 1X2 for Bet365/Pinnacle/WH (16/30 wanted columns) + **Pinnacle closing 1X2** (PSCH/PSCD/PSCA). Missing from the file: Bet365 closing 1X2, William Hill closing 1X2, and ALL total-goals columns (B365 and Pinnacle, pre-close and closing).
- **2025/26: COMPLETE, not partial** — the file holds 380 rows (season ended May 2026). Bookmaker set changed: WH 1X2 (pre-close and closing) entirely absent; everything else present (Bet365 + Pinnacle pre-close/closing 1X2, OU2.5 pre-close/closing).
- **True opening (O_OPEN)**: no free public bulk source for any season/bookmaker.

## 2. Source verification (fetched 2026-10-01)

URL pattern `https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/<SSSS>/I1.csv`:

| File | Rows | Bet365 1X2 pre-close/close | Pinnacle 1X2 pre-close/close | WH 1X2 pre-close/close | OU2.5 (B365 pre-close/close; Pinnacle pre-close/close) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1819/I1.csv | 380 | pre-close only / **closing ABSENT** | pre-close / closing ✓ | pre-close only / **closing ABSENT** | **all ABSENT** |
| 1920/I1.csv | 380 | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ |
| 2021/I1.csv | 380 | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ |
| 2526/I1.csv | 380 (complete) | ✓ / ✓ | ✓ / ✓ | **ABSENT / ABSENT** | ✓ / ✓ |

Verified sample rows (row-level evidence):
- `1819/I1.csv`, 18/08/2018 **Lazio–Napoli**: B365H 2.8 (no B365CH column); PSH 2.9 → PSCH 2.78; WHH 2.8 (no WHCH column); no OU columns
- `1920/I1.csv`, 24/08/2019 **Fiorentina–Napoli**: B365H 4.75 → B365CH 4.33; PSH 5.12 → PSCH 4.52; WHH 4.8 → WHCH 4.5; B365>2.5 1.8 → B365C>2.5 1.66; P>2.5 1.85 → PC>2.5 1.72
- `2021/I1.csv`, 19/09/2020 **Verona–Roma**: B365H 3.75 → B365CH 4.33; PSH 3.95 → PSCH 4.88; WHH 3.8 → WHCH 4.5; B365>2.5 1.8 → B365C>2.5 1.72; P>2.5 1.81 → PC>2.5 1.79
- `2526/I1.csv`, 23/08/2025 **Sassuolo–Napoli**: B365H 6.0 → B365CH 5.75; PSH 6.35 → PSCH 6.1; B365>2.5 1.98 → B365C>2.5 2.03; P>2.5 2.02 → PC>2.5 2.0; no WH columns

Field semantics (official, verbatim https://www.football-data.co.uk/notes.txt): base columns = pre-closing ("Betting odds for weekend games are collected Friday afternoons, and on Tuesday afternoons for midweek games."); `C`-suffix = closing. Pre-close must not be relabeled as opening.

## 3. Shadow use (O_OPEN / O_CLOSE / O_INTERVAL)

- O_CLOSE: supported for Bet365/Pinnacle/WH 1X2 and B365/Pinnacle OU2.5 in 2019/20, 2020/21, 2025/26 (except WH 2025/26 — absent); in 2018/19 only for **Pinnacle 1X2** (PSCH/PSCD/PSCA).
- O_INTERVAL: the same-bookmaker pre-closing→closing pair is strict-provenance SAFE **only where both columns exist** — report it as `pre_closing_to_closing`, never as true opening→closing.
- O_OPEN: not supported by any recovered record. Do not infer opening from closing or pre-close; do not use API-Football as odds.
- Qimen provenance: no F/I/G/M palace tokens derived; no pre-match qimen_output.json material in any source. Unavailable — local gate.

## 4. Audit (field level; 10 fields per fixture: 3 bookmakers × 2 1X2 semantics + 2 bookmakers × 2 OU2.5 semantics)

Focus seasons 2018/19–2020/21 (1140 fixtures × 10 = 11400 fields):
- expected: 11400
- discovered: 9120 (public bulk row-level source at documented semantics)
- complete: 9120 (2019/20: 3800; 2020/21: 3800; 2018/19: 1520 = pre-close 1X2 ×3 bookmakers + Pinnacle closing 1X2, 380 each)
- partial: 0
- missing: 2280 (all in 2018/19: Bet365 closing 1X2 380 + WH closing 1X2 380 + OU2.5 pre-close/closing ×2 bookmakers 1520)
- missing_as_true_opening: 11400 (no free public bulk source)

2025/26 completeness check: file holds **380 rows — season complete, not partial**. Missing from bulk: William Hill 1X2 pre-close+closing (760 fields, WH dropped from the 2526 file).

audit.note: 2018/19 file carries only pre-close 1X2 (B365/PS/WH) + Pinnacle closing 1X2; B365/WH closing and all OU2.5 columns absent. 2019/20 and 2020/21 fully covered. Counts at pre-close+closing semantics; true opening unavailable from any free bulk source.
